item.title: Claude Chill：修复 Claude Code 在终端中的闪烁问题
item.description:

交互式演示（与人工智能对战，检查日志）和完整的方法论/文章如下：https://so-long-sucker.vercel.app/

Top 12 Comments:

cush:

rkrueger11:

不太清楚为什么今天发布此内容。然而，我看到很多混乱/评论中存在错误信息，因此这里对 RCS 的工作原理进行了简化解释，同时认识到该主题在技术和商业上更加复杂。 （来源&免责声明：我是 Twilio 的产品经理，从事 RCS 工作。）

Google 于 2015 年收购了 Jibe Mobile。[1] GSMA 通用配置文件 (UP) 定义了 RCS 功能的行业标准。 [2] 消息传递应用程序（例如，Google Messages 或 iOS 上的消息）实现这些功能，运营商通过 MaaP（消息传递平台）公开它们。 GSMA 定期发布 UP 更新； UP v3 于 2025 年 2 月发布 [3]，不过最新的公开 iOS 版本支持 UP v2.4。

全球大多数运营商现在都使用 Google 的 Jibe MaaP，而不是自行构建，因为 Google Messages 支持 Jibe MaaP。这一选择减少了以前产生许多不一致的 Android 消息传递体验的碎片。此外，我认为 E2EE 加密仅在 v3 中添加到 UP 中，Google 之前已将其添加到规范之外的 Google Messages 中，因此只有当两个用户都使用 Google Messages 时才有效。

iOS Messages 在技术上可以支持任何 MaaP，因为下载的运营商配置文件指定要使用哪个 MaaP URL。

MaaP 支持个人对个人 (P2P) 和应用程序对个人 (A2P) RCS。 P2P RCS 使用电话号码。目前，运营商通常不会在公司用于短信的商务电话号码上启用 RCS。对于 A2P RCS，企业必须在 MaaP 中创建一个聊天机器人代理实体，并拥有自己的图像、显示名称和联系方式。 Google 的 MaaP 为企业提供了一个界面来创建这些 RCS 代理配置文件；然后运营商批准哪些代理可以在其网络上向订户发送消息。从理论上讲，这也有助于使消息传递客户端更轻松地减少垃圾邮件。欺诈，因为来自合法企业的流量与 P2P 欺诈流量更容易区分——无论是从技术角度（电话号码与聊天机器人/代理实体）还是从最终用户体验（经过验证和品牌的显示与匿名电话号码）。

如果您是企业，品牌，有兴趣开始使用 RCS，请查看此页面，了解有关如何开始使用 RCS 的更多信息：https://www.twilio.com/en-us/消息传递/频道/rcs

1. https://techcrunch.com/2015/09/30/google-acquires-jibe-mobil... 2. https://www.gsma.com/解决方案和影响/技术/网络... 3. https://www.gsma.com/解决方案和影响/技术/网络...

item.description:
最近，我看到了一种朝着最小化或不存在的代码审查的趋势，声称我们应该从“验证架构”转向“验证行为”。然而，事情很快就走下坡路。我个人不能接受交付未经审查的代码。

我每天在工作中都使用 Augment 和 Claud Opus 4.5。我几乎不再用手写代码了。我不会盲目接受它编写的代码，我会迭代它。我们在工作中审查代码。 I have absolutely found a lot of benefit from my tools.

I've implemented several medium-scale projects that I anticipate would have taken 1-2 weeks manually, and took a day or so using agentic tools.

A few very concrete advantages I've found:

* I can spin up several agents in parallel and cycle between them. Reviewing the output of one while the others crank away.

* It's greatly improved my ability in languages I'm not expert in. For example, I wrote a Chrome extension which I've maintained for a decade or so.我的 Javascript 能力很弱。 I pointed Antigravity at it and gave it a very open-ended prompt (basically, "improve this extension") and in about five minutes in vastly improved the quality of the extension (better UI, performance, removed dependencies).对于 JS 专家来说，这些改进可能很容易，但我不是。

这是我遵循的非常有效的方法：

1。尽可能清楚地告诉代理商您的规格。告诉代理分析代码并根据您的规范制定计划。告诉代理不要在未咨询您的情况下进行任何更改。

2.与代理一起迭代该计划，直到您认为这是一个好主意。

3.让代理人逐步实施您的计划。告诉客服人员在每个步骤之间暂停并获取您的输入。

4.在每个步骤之间，查看代理做了什么，并告诉它对您注意到的计划进行任何更正或修改。 （我发现这有助于提醒他们总体计划是什么，因为有时他们会忘记......）。

5。 Once the code is completed (or even between each step), I like to run a code-cleanup subagent that maintains the logic but improves style (factors out magic constants, helper functions, etc.)

This works quite well for me.由于这些是基于文本的界面，我发现散文的清晰度有很大的不同。非常仔细和明确地向代理商提供的规格至关重要。

If you can't get it to get it right, you may legitimately have something it sucks at. Although as you iterate might also have some other insights into why it keeps getting it wrong and can maybe change something more substantial about your setup to make it able to get it right.

For example I have a custom xml/css UI solution that draws inspiration both from XML and SwiftUI, and it does an OK job of making UIs for it. But sometimes it gets stuck in ways it wouldn't if it was using HTML or some known (and probably higher quality/less buggy) UI library. 我也有类似的问题，现在仍在评估。然而，我对法学硕士辅助编码的赞成和反对者提供的大量轶事证据越来越感到沮丧。我个人觉得它有时会提高生产力，但也会让其他人感到沮丧。

The tool is there to make doing check-ins easier, basically a tiny CLI wrapper around journaling that stays out of my way. It also does some static analysis on commit frequency, code produced, etc. but I haven't fleshed out that part of it much and have been doing manual analysis at the end of blocks.

For me this kind of self-tracking has been more helpful than hearsay, since I can directly point to periods where it was working well and try to figure out why or what I was working on. It's not fool-proof, obviously, but for me the intentionality has helped me get clearer answers.

Whether those results translate beyond a single engineer isn't a question I'm interested in answering and feels like a variant of developer metrics-black-hole, but maybe we'll get more rigorous experiments in time.

fotcorn:

我在 Cursor 中使用 Claude Opus 4.5 编写 RISC-V Vector/SIMD 代码。具体来说是 CNN 的深度卷积和普通卷积层。

我首先让它编写一个没有内在函数的简单 C 版本，并根据 PyTorch 版本对其进行验证。

然后我要求它（以及其他两个模型，Gemini 3.0 和 GPT 5.1）提出一些关于如何使用 SIMD 向量指令使其更快的想法，并将其写为 markdown 文件。

最后，我通过给出光标指向这三个 Markdown 文件、简单的 C 代码和有关如何编译代码的更多信息，以及可以上传程序并测试它的 SSH 命令。

然后测试了几个不同的变体，在目标（RISC-V SBC、OrangePI RV2）上运行它以检查它是否改进了运行时间，然后从那里继续。它这样做了 10 次，直到到达最终版本。

最终代码非常可读，并且比我迄今为止发现的任何其他库或编译器都要快。我认为清晰的护栏（输出必须与 PyTorch 的参考输出完全匹配，性能必须比以前更好）使得这项工作非常顺利。

vessenes:

是的，它有效。 Like anything getting the most out of these tools is its own (human) skill.

With that in mind, a couple of comments - think of the coding agents as personalities with blind spots.由所有人进行代码审查和综合步骤是一个好主意。事实上，目前流行的是“5规则”，这意味着你需要LLM复习五次，并改变复习的级别，例如： bugs, architecture, structure, etc. Anecdotally, I find this is extremely effective.

Right now, Claude is in my opinion the best coding agent out there.有了 Claude 代码，最好的工具就开始自动化审查 / PR process a bit, but the hand holding around bugs is real.

I also really like Yegge’s beads for LLMs keeping state and track of what they’re doing — upshot, I suggest you install beads, load Claude, run ‘!bd prime’ and say “Give me a full, thorough code review for all sorts of bugs, architecture, incorrect tests, specification, usability, code bugs, plus anything else you see, and write out beads based on your findings.”然后你可以让克劳德（或法典）研究它们。但您可能会发现新的视角可以节省时间，例如give Claude a try for a day.

Your ‘duplicated code’ complaint is likely an artifact of how codex interacts with your codebase - codex in particular likes to load smaller chunks of code in to do work, and sometimes it can get too little context. You can always just cat the relevant files right into the context, which can be helpful.

Finally, iOS is a tough target — I’d expect a few more bumps. The vast bulk of iOS apps are not up on GitHub, so there’s less facility in the coding models.

And any front end work doesn’t really have good native visual harnesses set up, (although Claude has the Claude chrome extension for web UIs).所以将会有更多的来回。

无论如何 - 如果你是一名职业工程师，我会告诉你 - 学习这些东西。这将是你在很短的时间内工作的方式。如果您是业余爱好者，那就玩得开心，做任何您想做的事。

proc0:

我的经历也是一样的。简而言之，代理商无法提前计划，也无法进行高层次的计划。这意味着他们存在设计盲点。 Since they cannot design properly, it limits the kind of projects that are viable to smaller scopes (not sure exactly how small but in my experience, extremely small and simple). Anything that exceeds this abstract threshold has a good chance of being a net negative, with most of the code being unmantainable, unextensible, and unreliable.

Anyone who claims AI is great is not building a large or complex enough app, and when it works for their small project, they extrapolate to all possibilities.因此，因为他们的示例是根据提示生成的，所以错误地认为任何提示都可以工作。这并不一定是这样的。

现实是编程被广泛低估了。人们认为它只是文本文件上的语法，但它实际上更像是一个带有活动部件的巨型抽象机器。如果你没有看到带有移动部件的巨型机器，那么你很可能不会构建出好的软件。 For AI to do this, it would require strong reasoning capabilities, that lets it derive logical structures, along with long term planning and simulation of this abstract machine. I predict that if AI can do this then it will be able to do every single other job, including physical jobs as it would be able to reason within a robotic body in the physical world.

To summarize, people are underestimating programming, using their simple projects to incorrectly extrapolate to any possible prompt, and missing the hard part of programming which involves building abstract machines that work on first principles and mathematical logic.
